notes: Custom dictionaries created by the wizard as <prefix>-Dict-<key>. Predefined Zscaler dictionaries are referenced as predefined:<internal name>. NPI uses Zscaler's predefined NPI dictionary (NPI_LEAKAGE) instead of a custom one (FWK-20 reuse). v2.8: engines can combine dictionaries (AND, OR, AND NOT, match counts); ZIA does not accept a sum of dictionaries, so bulk tiers count each identifier on its own. The structure of these additions (labelled identifiers, condition markers used only with an identifier, bulk tiers, source code structure plus statements, decontrol exclusions) follows Jason Smith's DLP content in Zscaler Made Easy; the patterns and phrases here are written for the wizard.

ICD10.name: ICD10-Diagnosis
ICD10.description: ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes (letter + 2 characters + decimal subcode) near diagnosis keywords.

source.title: CDC/NCHS ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2026 (code structure)

MBI.name: Medicare-MBI
MBI.description: Medicare Beneficiary Identifier: 11 characters in the CMS-defined position pattern.

MRN.name: Medical-Record-Number
MRN.description: Medical record numbers labelled MRN / Medical Record Number.

source.title: 45 CFR 164.514(b)(2)(i)(H) — medical record numbers are a HIPAA identifier

CARD_TRACK.name: Card-Track-Data
CARD_TRACK.description: Magnetic-stripe track 1 / track 2 data (sensitive authentication data).

source.title: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Requirement 3.3.1 — SAD (full track) not retained

CUI_MARKINGS.name: CUI-Markings
CUI_MARKINGS.description: Controlled Unclassified Information banner and portion markings.

source.title: NARA CUI Registry and marking guidance

CJI_TERMS.name: CJI-Records
CJI_TERMS.description: Criminal Justice Information record terms (CHRI, NCIC, III, FBI/UCN/SID numbers).

source.title: FBI CJIS Security Policy v6.0 — definition of CJI

STUDENT_RECORDS.name: Student-Records
STUDENT_RECORDS.description: Education record terms defined by FERPA.

MNPI.name: MNPI-Financial
MNPI.description: Material non-public information and pre-release financial reporting terms.

FTI_MARKINGS.name: FTI-Markings
FTI_MARKINGS.description: Federal Tax Information labels and IRC 6103 references (Pub 1075 requires FTI to be labelled and protected in transit).

DOB_LABEL.name: Date-of-Birth
DOB_LABEL.description: Dates of birth with a DOB / Date of Birth label (a HIPAA identifier). Label and value must both be present.

source.title: 45 CFR 164.514(b)(2)(i)(C): dates directly related to an individual, including birth date

HEALTH_PLAN_ID.name: Health-Plan-Member-ID
HEALTH_PLAN_ID.description: Health plan member, subscriber or group numbers with their label (a HIPAA identifier).

PHI_SENSITIVE.name: PHI-Sensitive-Conditions
PHI_SENSITIVE.description: Conditions with extra legal protection: substance use disorder (42 CFR Part 2), HIV, psychotherapy notes and genetic test results.

source.title: 42 CFR Part 2 (SUD records); 45 CFR 164.501 (psychotherapy notes); GINA Title II (genetic information)

CLINICAL_NOTES.name: Clinical-Note-Terms
CLINICAL_NOTES.description: Words that appear in clinical notes and discharge documents. Used together with an identifier, never alone.

source.title: HL7 C-CDA document and section types (Discharge Summary, Progress Note, Assessment and Plan)

CUI_LEGACY.name: CUI-Legacy-Markings
CUI_LEGACY.description: Legacy markings that CUI replaced but documents still carry: FOUO, LES, SBU, and distribution statements B to F.

source.title: 32 CFR 2002 and DoDI 5200.48 (legacy markings, distribution statements)

CUI_DECONTROL.name: CUI-Decontrolled
CUI_DECONTROL.description: Markings that show a document has been decontrolled; used to exclude those documents from the CUI rule.

SRC_ANCHOR.name: Source-Code-Structure
SRC_ANCHOR.description: Lines that only appear in program source: imports, includes, function and class declarations (Java, C, C#, Python, Go, Rust, JavaScript).

source.title: Language references: Java SE (import), ISO C (#include), C# (using), Python (def), Go (func), Rust (fn), Node.js (require)

SRC_SIGNAL.name: Source-Code-Statements
SRC_SIGNAL.description: Statements common to most C-family and scripting languages (return, if, for, try / catch, throw). Counted together with the structure dictionary.

source.title: Common statement syntax (ECMA-262, Java SE, C#)

SECRETS_KEYS.name: Secrets-and-Keys
SECRETS_KEYS.description: Private keys and cloud or SaaS access tokens with a fixed, recognisable format.

source.title: Published token formats: AWS access keys, GitHub tokens, Slack tokens, Google API keys, Stripe and GitLab keys; RFC 7468 (PEM)
